title: BOGGS IN ACTION--DEFENSE CONSTRUED INTO OFFENSE
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Published 1900 by George Q. Cannon & Sons. Detailed history of the Missouri period persecutions of the Latter-day Saints.

footnotes.text: This was Lilburn W. Boggs who, during the troubles in Jackson County, was lieutenant-governor of the State, and who not only quietly looked on and saw the saints driven from their homes by mob violence, but secretly aided and encouraged the mob in its atrocities.
